scope: Move R1207 slightly up/left; relocate and rotate R1201 beside the existing ARMED via; replace one exact ILM segment and add short ARMED/GND connections. No new vias. Rules, fixed mechanical interfaces, other 77 source members unchanged.
mounted_face: All native keepouts preserved, with only the two owned BODY guards rigidly transformed with their components. New ILM/ARM traces escape outward. Ground uses deliberate bends above R1413 drain land. Native DRC has no non-connectivity violation. Minimum nominal courtyard gap is 0.025 mm; this is not measured assembly clearance.
reference: Eight added B.Cu segments have continuous In4 reference outside their own existing transfer void. No retained trace loses reference copper. Six inherited transition-screen flags remain. All old pad pairs, 50 power-width checks, 155 GND pads and 63 critical adjacency checks retained.

opposite_face_review.ILM: Complete ILM copper projection on L901 nominal Fab body reduces from 0.410787 mm2 to zero; total ILM track length reduces 6.958560 to 6.224676 mm. Projected copper separation from U901 SW grows 5.95 to 6.65 mm. These are geometric measurements, not a coupling or <50 pF capacitance result.
opposite_face_review.R1207: Opposite-face body projection on L901 reduces 1.32 to 0.804375 mm2; ground and ILM pad distances to U1201 shrink. Ground remains connected to actual GND pin 8; PGTH pin 4 is not substituted for pin 8. Quiet star/Kelvin return impedance is not qualified.
opposite_face_review.R1201: 100k ARMED pulldown now lies under the output-side edge of L901 nominal body; 1.32 mm2 nominal body overlap. Short 1.135660 mm ARM connection reuses the existing via and avoids the SW node. It is also close to the unchanged dump resistors: hot-state bias/noise and assembly remain NOT_TESTED.
opposite_face_review.GND_bridge: Only the four new GND bridge segments intersect the opposite-face native L901 BODY guard. In4 copper under them is continuous. This reconnects the two-pad ground island created by the placement trial without another hole. No buck/SW/feedback power copper is modified. Reference copper cannot establish magnetic shielding or thermal suitability.

datasheet_review.application: Short ILM/support connections and quiet device ground; avoid switching coupling; ILM parasitic target below 50 pF requires separate extraction/validation. Local geometry improves; full compliance remains open.
Keep switching/feedback loops compact and separated, with appropriate ground/Kelvin returns. Existing converter placement and copper preserved; no new full-converter qualification.

remaining_limits: 32 unconnected items, including three ARMED groups.
Quiet-ground/star/Kelvin impedance, ILM parasitic capacitance and actual coupling NOT_TESTED.
Six historical return-screen flags remain; 2 mm is a project screening heuristic.
Hot-state resistance/thresholds, dump-pulse effects, inductor temperature, EMC and assembled fit NOT_TESTED.
